    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersLex's gala canapésBlinis with crème fraîche and smoked salmon, figs with goat's cheese and honeyHow to make it16 blinis200g smoked salmon200ml crème fraîche6 fresh figs150g goat's cheese2 tbsp honeyHalve the figs and tear the salmon into small folds.Top each blini with crème fraîche and smoked salmon.Top each fig half with goat's cheese and a drizzle of honey.Arrange both on silver trays.Smoked trout crispbreadsRye crispbread with crème fraîche, smoked trout, pickled onion and dillHow to make it1 packet rye crispbread200g smoked trout200ml crème fraîche1 jar pickled onions1 bunch dillSlice a few pickled onions into rings and pick the dill into sprigs.Spread the crispbreads with crème fraîche.Flake the trout over the top and finish with onion rings and dill.Serve cold on a slate.Martha Kent's corn frittersMartha Kent's farm in KansasHow to make itAs written, serves 4Corn kernels mixed with flour, egg and spring onion, fried in spoonfuls until golden, with sour cream.Mix 100g self-raising flour with 1 egg, 100ml milk, half a teaspoon smoked paprika and salt into a thick batter.Stir in the kernels from 3 corn cobs and 3 sliced spring onions.Heat 5mm of oil in a frying pan and drop in tablespoons of batter, cooking 2 minutes a side until golden.Drain on paper towel.Mix 200g sour cream with chopped chives and lime zest and serve with the hot fritters.MainsMetropolis gala beef WellingtonBeef fillet wrapped in mushrooms, prosciutto and puff pastryHow to make it1kg beef eye fillet2 tbsp Dijon mustard400g mushrooms2 garlic cloves100g prosciutto2 sheets of puff pastry1 egg2 tbsp olive oilsalt and pepper, to tasteChop the mushrooms very fine and crush the garlic.Season the beef with salt and pepper, sear it all over in hot oil, then brush with mustard and cool.Cook the mushrooms with garlic until dry.Lay prosciutto on a pastry sheet, spread with mushrooms and wrap around the beef, sealing with the second sheet. Brush with egg.Bake at 210°C.Rest before slicing.Daily Planet chicken club sandwichesLois and Clark at the Daily PlanetHow to make itAs written, serves 4Club sandwiches of grilled chicken, crisp bacon, avocado and tomato on toasted bread with mayo, stacked three high and cut into triangles.Season 2 chicken breasts, grill 6 minutes a side and slice.Cook 8 rashers bacon until crisp.Toast 12 slices white bread.Spread 4 slices with mayo and layer with chicken, sliced tomato and lettuce.Add a second slice of toast, spread with mayo, and layer with bacon and sliced avocado.Top with a third slice, push 4 toothpicks through and cut each into 4 triangles.Serve with potato crisps.SweetsWayne gala chocolate souffléDark chocolate soufflés baked in ramekinsHow to make it150g dark chocolate4 eggs80g caster sugar20g butter200ml thickened creamButter and sugar four ramekins and heat the oven to 190°C.Melt the chocolate and stir in three egg yolks.Whisk the four egg whites with sugar to soft peaks and fold into the chocolate.Fill the ramekins and bake.Serve straight away with cream.DrinksLexCorp gala pear and ginger fizzPear nectar and fresh ginger syrup in a flute, topped up with bubblesHow to make it100g fresh ginger100g caster sugar100ml water1 lemon250ml pear nectar400ml sparkling wine40g candied gingerSlice the ginger and simmer with the sugar and water, then strain and cool.Chill four flutes. Juice the lemon.Pour pear nectar, ginger syrup and lemon juice into each flute.Top with sparkling wine and stir once gently.Thread candied ginger onto picks and rest across each glass.
